comment: Demonstration listings. These creators and services are examples, not real people or real offers.

creators.name: Maya R.
creators.bio: I draw mostly in pencil and ink, and I've been teaching friends to sketch for a few years. I like working with complete beginners best.
creators.availability: Weekday evenings and Sunday afternoons (UK time)

creators.name: Tom Okafor
creators.bio: Fantasy writer, two self-published novellas so far. Happy to read your opening chapter and tell you honestly what's working.

creators.name: Priya S.
creators.bio: Digital painter and hobby game developer. I make small pixel-art games and paint character portraits on an iPad.
creators.availability: Commissions open, two slots at a time

offerings.creator: demo-maya
offerings.title: Drawing hands without panicking
offerings.description: A relaxed hour in a small group. We'll break hands into simple shapes and draw a lot of bad ones on purpose.

offerings.creator: demo-maya
offerings.title: One-to-one sketch feedback
offerings.description: Send me a few sketches beforehand and we'll go through them together, then try one or two quick exercises.

offerings.creator: demo-tom
offerings.title: Opening chapter critique
offerings.description: Written notes on your first 3,000 words, then a 30-minute call to talk them through.

offerings.creator: demo-tom
offerings.title: Planning a short story in an evening
offerings.description: A 25-minute recorded walkthrough of how I plan a short story, with the worksheet I use.

offerings.creator: demo-priya
offerings.title: Character portrait, bust, digital
offerings.description: A painted head-and-shoulders portrait of your character with a simple background.
offerings.conditions: Personal use only; ask about commercial use. One sketch revision and one colour revision included. I keep the right to show it in my portfolio unless you'd rather I didn't.

offerings.creator: demo-priya
offerings.title: Your first pixel-art sprite
offerings.description: We'll make a 32 by 32 character and give it a two-frame walk cycle. No experience needed.
